source.book: Montesinos-Lopez, Montesinos-Lopez & Crossa, Multivariate Statistical Machine Learning Methods for Genomic Prediction
source.section: 2.4 Methods to Compute the Genomic Relationship Matrix
source.after: VanRaden, P.M. (2008). Efficient methods to compute genomic predictions. J Dairy Sci 91(11):4414-4423
source.note: All values below are HAND-TRANSCRIBED from the printed pages, never produced by running morie.

transcription_check.note: colMeans(X)/2 reproduces the book's printed phat exactly; this validates the matrix transcription independently of any G.

method1.printed_formula: G = (1/p) X X^T,  p = number of markers
method1.DISCREPANCY: XX^T/7 (markers, per the stated formula) does NOT reproduce the printed table; XX^T/8 (lines) does. UNRESOLVED - awaiting maintainer ruling.

method2.status: formula reproduces the printed table exactly; no discrepancy

method3.DISCREPANCY: the stated formula does NOT reproduce the printed table; the R code (sample SD, ddof=1) does. VanRaden's original uses the sqrt(2p(1-p)) scaling, so the book's R code is likely the error. UNRESOLVED - awaiting maintainer ruling.

identity_properties: G is positive semi-definite (all eigenvalues >= 0 up to numerical tolerance)
